narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a technical tutorial for DJI camera users, specifically those using the Osmo Pocket series. It aims to educate viewers on how to enable the internal audio backup feature to prevent data loss in case external microphones fail, using a real-world 'failed' scenario as evidence for why the setting is crucial.
